purpose: Exact 1:1 reconstruction of this repository's files for agents whose web fetcher strips HTML/JSX-like tags from plain-text responses. JSON responses pass those fetchers untouched (verified empirically by the agent that inspired this bundle).
how_to_reconstruct: 1. For each entry in files[]: mkdir -p the dirname of 'path', then write 'content' to 'path' verbatim (it is the exact file text).
2. 'bytes' and 'sha256' let you verify each file after writing (sha256 of the utf-8 encoded content).
3. Root-level files go in the project root; everything else follows its repo-relative path.

channels_if_you_have_more_tools.code_execution_no_unzip: GitHub contents API returns JSON with base64 content - tag-proof by construction: https://api.github.com/repos/SonaMother/peach-goma-skyhop-3d-cat-platformer/contents/<path>?ref=main (decode .content with atob/base64 -d; also works for gameproject.zip itself)
channels_if_you_have_more_tools.human_readable: RECREATE_PROJECT.md in repo root (do NOT fetch this if your fetcher strips tags - use these shards instead)

regenerable.package-lock.json: recreate via npm install if shard-06 is too large for your fetch cap
